verdict.rationale: First-party docs say ChatGPT can read files, analyze data and summarize findings (docs-90, docs-66). It can turn analysis into documents and spreadsheets (docs-68), and it pulls insights from connected sources such as Google Drive, Salesforce and Slack (docs-87, docs-64, docs-26). Community users praise file interpretation and document retrieval (comm-6) but warn that answers can be plausible yet wrong and that it is weak with numbers (comm-4). missing for 10: in-depth docs on the data-analysis workflow (e.g., generated charts or proactive suggestions), independent hands-on confirmation that its data insights are accurate.
